headline: Maui Planning Commission Meeting

meeting.summary: The commission recommended a West Maui plan change to rebuild fire-destroyed homes, approved a bed and breakfast permit, and set two hearing schedules.
meeting.recap: The planning department proposed a plan change so homes lost in the August 8, 2023 fire can be rebuilt.[[0:06:42]] The commission's motion to recommend the amendment passed with five votes.[[0:26:02]] Its conditions allow two guests per bedroom, one group at a time, and three parking stalls.[[1:23:51]] The commission took up a permit request for up to 53 single-family lots on about 28 acres.[[1:39:09]] It set a contested case hearing (a formal, trial-like hearing) on that request for February 11.[[3:05:59]] A county attorney said state land officials told him the shoreline there cannot be certified until encroachments are removed.[[3:26:47]] The commission moved that appeal hearing to January 14.[[4:53:26]] The parties will return to mediation (talks led by a neutral helper).[[4:57:39]] The commission delayed its decision on discovery (collecting evidence from other parties) until November 12.[[5:00:31]]
decided: The commission agreed by unanimous consent to hear item B2 before item B1.
meeting.next: The special management area permit for the neighborhood will come back to the commission for a consistency finding. The remaining agenda items were deferred.
